title: WorkFile
description: Contents of data/works/<last character of id>/<id>.json: one work and its public logs. Unknown properties are allowed so that producers can add fields without breaking older generators.

id.description: Also the file name without .json. The file sits in the directory named by the last character of the id.

type.description: Media type. Known values: movie, tv, streaming, music, book, other. Unknown values are rendered as other.

path.description: Directory path separated by "/", for example "movies/2026". May be empty.

coverUrl.description: An https URL, or an empty string.

season.description: Broadcast season, for example "2026-autumn" (winter: Jan-Mar, spring: Apr-Jun, summer: Jul-Sep, autumn: Oct-Dec). May be empty.

episodeCount.description: Total number of episodes, when known.

channel.description: Broadcast channel of the work, for example "NHK総合". May be empty.

airtime.description: The regular slot as free text, for example "日曜 21:00〜21:45". May be empty.

genres.description: Genres as ARIB STD-B10 content genres, main one first: the major and the minor genre as two hex digits ("30" is ドラマ / 国内ドラマ), or the major alone ("3").

officialUrl.description: An https URL of the official page of the work, or an empty string.

id.description: Unique within the work. Used as a URL segment.

episode.description: Episode number watched in this log.

episodeEnd.description: Last episode when one log covers several; ignored unless greater than episode.

source.description: Where the program info came from, for example "nhk" or "manual". May be empty.

url.description: An https URL of the official program page, or an empty string.
